id: \bWelcome, \PN. I know everything there is to know about you. This battle should be delightful, as I already know what will happen.
en: \bWelcome, \PN. I know everything there is to know about you. This battle should be delightful, as I already know what will happen.
it: \bBenvenuto, \PN. So tutto quello che c'è da sapere su di te. Questa lotta sarà deliziosa, dato che so già cosa succederà.

id: \bCongratulations on winning your third round. Your next match will be a full battle in the Top 8.
en: \bCongratulations on winning your third round. Your next match will be a full battle in the Top 8.
it: \bCongratulazioni per aver vinto il terzo turno. Il tuo prossimo incontro sarà una lotta completa nei Top 8.

id: \bBarry: Oh no! I'm not losing this time.
en: \bBarry: Oh no! I'm not losing this time.

id: \bBarry: Grr... next time it's a million dollar fine!
en: \bBarry: Grr... next time it's a million dollar fine!
it: \bBarry: Grr... la prossima volta ti becchi una multa da un milione!

id: \bCongratulations on making it past the Top 8. Your next battle will be in the Semi-Finals.
en: \bCongratulations on making it past the Top 8. Your next battle will be in the Semi-Finals.
it: \bCongratulazioni per aver superato i Top 8. La tua prossima lotta sarà in semifinale.
